page.title: Bitcoin Recovery Reaches $83,000 as Crash Fears Ease
page.excerpt: Bitcoin (BTC▲$80,228.00) rebounded to around $83,000 on Monday, October 19, after dipping to $80,500 on Sunday — a Bitcoin recovery that ran alongside rising US equity futures and predictions of a fresh market crash that never showed up in early trading. The bounce followed last week’s slide from above $84,000 to below $80,000, set off when US inflation reports came in hotter than expected.
